author: reek
body: One channel handed over for a DIFFERENT channel. Neither contains the other, and this refusal is the channel family's ANSWER rather than the absence of one: scope-subsumes asks a Console scope whether it contains another, and a channel contains only itself.

author: reek
body: That is what makes this different from its filesystem sibling, which is the same shape and is ACCEPTED: effect-widen-scope-narrow hands "/config/app/" to a "/config/" parameter and passes, because a path does contain what extends it. One relation, asked of two families, two answers. Run both through a single text-starts-with and "stdout" would sit inside "std".
